Every acceptance criterion in the review request was satisfied.

issues: Console warning repeated: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' from Radix. Non-blocking a11y improvement — add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to buy/checkout/comment dialogs.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py public_store_order (line 878): server-side price recompute using db.products is correctly used as source of truth; manipulated `price` and `name` from client are ignored — validated by test.

server.py stripe_webhook (line 974): uses stripe.Webhook.construct_event with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and returns 400 on failure — matches contract. Update uses idempotent guard `payment_status: {\"$ne\": \"paid\"}` which prevents duplicate paid_at.
server.py public_checkout_status (line 956): correctly returns DB payment_status plus live stripe_status without flipping DB — respects rule that webhook is single source of truth.

ClientGallery.jsx finalizeOrder (line 87): early-return `if (placing) return;` + Button `disabled={placing}` + label switch to 'A redirecionar...' — debounce validated (1 request on rapid double-click).

ClientGallery.jsx line 215: static text below Pagar shows 'Sem pagamento online — o estúdio contacta-te para tratar do pagamento.' — this is STALE/WRONG now that Stripe is live. Consider replacing with the message in the checkout dialog ('Pagamento seguro processado pela Stripe...'). Low-priority copy fix.

server.py line 943 success_url: uses `{origin}/payment/success?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}` — origin comes from `body.get('origin_url')`. If a malicious client sends an arbitrary origin_url, Stripe will still redirect there. Not a security bug on Stripe side but consider validating origin against an allowlist.
server.py file is 2250 lines — beyond the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules (galleries, store, payments, portal, receivables, etc.).
Radix a11y warnings on DialogContent for buy-modal / checkout / comment dialogs — add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby (non-blocking).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe TEST integration fully working: webhook is registered by sandbox to /api/stripe/webhook and reliably flips payment_status='paid' within seconds. To reproduce hosted-checkout completion you MUST also fill Phone number on the Stripe form (required in this sandbox) besides card/exp/CVC/name/ZIP; without it the Pay button stays in 'Processing' forever. Use `page.set_viewport_size({'width':1440,'height':900})` and `input[name="cardNumber|cardExpiry|cardCvc|billingName|billingPostalCode|phoneNumber"]` selectors. Session ID is embedded in the Stripe URL as cs_test_...; capture with regex `(cs_test_[A-Za-z0-9]+)` to poll our backend after redirect. Note: fetches from checkout.stripe.com iframe context are blocked by CSP — verify status via curl to our backend instead.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Payment feature works end-to-end.
